desc: Opening. The Mirzapur mela at blue hour: ferris wheel, stalls, thousands of people. Camera drifts in over the lights toward the crowd.
mov: Drone push in + slow tilt down
notes: Super: GHANTA 00 (timestamp style used through the film). Mixed sodium + LED fairy-light palette. Sets scale before we go small.
audio: VO: 'Shaam ke 7 baj rahe the.' + mela ambience

desc: Dense crowd compressed through the ferris wheel spokes; heads, balloons, food smoke.
notes: Long-lens compression = claustrophobia. Plant red balloons in frame, but not dominant yet.
audio: VO: 'Mirzapur ke mele mein chaaron taraf bas bheed hi bheed thi.'

desc: The Gupta family (parents + kids) walking through the stalls, laughing, eating.
mov: Gimbal follow from behind, arcs to frontal
notes: Warm, happy grade. This is the last 'normal' moment of the film.
audio: VO: 'Isi bheed mein Gupta family bhi thi...'

desc: Dhruv (8) holding father's finger, blue jacket, zip held shut with a safety pin.
notes: IMPORTANT PLANT: the safety pin on the zip must be visible here. Pays off in Shot 78.
audio: VO: 'Aur unhi bachchon mein tha 8 saal ka Dhruv.'

desc: Dhruv's POV: a cluster of balloons on a vendor's pole across the crowd. One red balloon catches the light.
mov: Static, rack focus crowd to balloons
notes: The red balloon is the film's motif. Keep it the only saturated red in frame.

desc: Dhruv tugging mother's dupatta, pointing, pleading. Parents are busy bargaining at a stall.
notes: Parents' faces cut off by the frame top: to Dhruv they are unreachable.
audio: VO: 'Blue jacket pehne Dhruv pichhle aadhe ghante se balloon lene ki zid kar raha tha.'

desc: Dhruv's hand slowly slips out of his father's hand.
notes: The inciting moment. Hold the empty hand for a beat after.
audio: VO: 'Jab kisi ne uski baat nahi suni...'

desc: Parents soft in the foreground, still bargaining. In the background Dhruv walks away and the crowd swallows him.
notes: Deep staging. Focus stays on Dhruv, parents unaware in the foreground.
audio: VO: '...to woh chupchaap balloon lene khud chala gaya.'

desc: Speed ramp: the crowd blurs, then snaps to normal speed. Mother turns, smile fading, looks down beside her. Empty.
notes: Super: +10 MIN. SFX: heartbeat thump on the rack.
audio: VO: 'Kareeb 10 minute baad gharwalon ko jab wo kahin nahi dikha...'

desc: Family scatters in different directions through the crowd, seen from above.
notes: Four figures splitting apart like a crack.
audio: VO: 'To unhe laga kisi jhoole ya dukaan ke paas ruk gaya hoga. Sab alag-alag taraf dhoondhne lage.'

desc: Quick inserts: father at the jhoola, mother at the toy stall, uncle near the food carts, each calling out 'Dhruv!'
notes: Fast cutting. Lose the geography on purpose; build panic.
audio: VO: 'Par Dhruv nahi mila.' + parents calling 'Dhruv!'

desc: Parents reach the balloon seller. Balloons frame the foreground.
notes: Seller half-hidden by his own balloons (quiet foreshadow; he is the suspect).
audio: VO: 'Dhoondhte-dhoondhte Dhruv ke maa-baap ek balloon bechne wale ke paas pahunche.'
Father: 'Bhaiya, blue jacket pehne ek chhota bachcha yahan aaya tha kya?'

desc: Balloon seller answers quickly and confidently, pointing toward the gate.
notes: He answers too fast. Play it neutral; the audience should not suspect him yet.
audio: Seller: 'Haan. Abhi kuch der pehle aaya tha. Lekin balloon lene se pehle do aadmi uske paas aaye...'

desc: RECREATION (seller's version): two men approach Dhruv, one thin with a black cap hands him a red balloon; they lead him to a white van. Faces never shown, backs and silhouettes only.
notes: 'Told' grade: desaturated, slight frame blur. Mirrored later in Shot 152 with the TRUE version.
audio: Seller (cont., as VO): '...Unhone use red balloon diya, white van mein bithaya... aur us gate se nikal gaye.'

desc: Father's face, sweat, the words landing. Mother's hand grips his arm.
audio: VO: 'Dhruv ke pita ke is ek sawal ke unhe 5 jawab mile. Aur jawab bhi aise the ki sun kar dono ke pasine chhoot gaye.'

desc: Crane up off the parents into the night sky; VFX map zoom-out from the mela to Mirzapur to UP to Lucknow HQ.
mov: Crane up into VFX map zoom
notes: Map style reused for every level of the hierarchy. Keep one consistent map graphic system.
audio: VO: 'Par ye dar sirf Gupta family tak rukne wala nahi tha. Mela Chowki ke Constable se lekar Lucknow mein baithe DGP tak - Dhruv ki talaash Police system ke har level ko hilane wali thi.'

desc: Macro montage of uniform details: shoulder stars, Ashoka emblem, belt buckle, name plate, badges. Graphic ladder of ranks builds up the screen.
notes: Dark background, hard rim light on the metal. Question text appears on screen: SHO? IO? CO?
audio: VO: 'Isliye hamare liye ye sirf kidnapping ka case nahi hai... SHO, IO, CO - ye ranks hain ya kuch aur?'

desc: TITLE: a single red balloon rises into the black sky. Title OPERATION RED BALLOON with RED in red.
mov: Static, balloon rises out of frame
notes: Title card. Music hit on the title.
audio: VO: 'Aur seedhi mein sabse upar pahunch kar hum is ek sawal ka jawab dhoondhenge, ki Police mein sabse powerful kaun hai.'
